faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IUST Programme Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IUST Programme Manager posts is 01 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Programme Manager position at the Islamic University of Science & Technology (IUST).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Programme Manager role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's Degree in Engineering, Public Policy, Public Administration, Management, Economics, Data Science, Urban Planning, Environmental Studies, Development Studies, or Social Work from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Programme Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Programme Manager post will receive a salary of Rs. 47,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the IUST Programme Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Programme Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes evaluation of Academic Merit (60 marks), Relevant Experience (20 marks), and a Personal Interview (20 marks).

faq.question: Q7. Is the IUST Programme Manager recruitment on a contractual basis?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment for the Programme Manager posts is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the apply mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online for the IUST Programme Manager recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IUST?
faq.answer: The official website of Islamic University of Science & Technology (IUST) is www.iust.ac.in.
